notes.title: Torn Tales: Rebound Edition has officially released!
notes.notes:
We made it! It's out!

If anyone has any questions/feedback the best place to find us is on our official Torn Tales Discord server: https://discord.gg/tHBE3qn

Even better we have a special multiplayer game on our Discord server which you can play completely for free!

Lastly, a special thank you to all of our beta testers, your feedback has helped us improve the game a lot over the last few months.
